## Selected Case Studies

- [Fi El Sekka Case Study](https://my-website-neon-ten-94.vercel.app/work/fi-el-sekka) · [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/eg/app/fi-el-sekka/id6813012849): Voice-first Egyptian-Arabic AI commuting app built 0→1 after 6 months of field research (20+ drivers/supervisors, 50+ commuters) and a Creativa validation sprint, uniting direct driver matching with Go Bus / Blue Bus / Otobeesy API booking.
- [Tride Case Study](https://my-website-neon-ten-94.vercel.app/work/tride) · [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/eg/app/tride-egypt/id6749056619) / [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.corevine.trideuser&pcampaignid=web_share): Two-sided Parent & Driver school mobility apps designed at Corevine with a Bosta PM founder, supporting individual seats or 4–5 child sibling and neighbor carpool groups.
- [Active Case Study](https://my-website-neon-ten-94.vercel.app/work/active-platform) · [Live Website](https://activksa.com/brands/): Multi-platform Saudi creator marketplace across Web, Brand Analytics Dashboard, and Flutter app replacing WhatsApp operations with fake-follower verification, campaign bidding, brand ratings, and MyFatoorah checkout.
- [Malahi Case Study](https://my-website-neon-ten-94.vercel.app/work/malahi) · [Live Website](https://malahi.com/ar): Enterprise 3D bilingual Saudi entertainment portal & live ticketing platform organizing age-segmented venues (Lamby, Wanoos, Fazz, Doos/Garage) with Vibe-Coded motion prototypes and developer-tuned media performance.

## Experience

- **Founder & Lead Product Designer — Fi El Sekka (Egypt)**: 0→1 field research, strategic pivot, Egyptian-Arabic Voice & Chat AI UX, brand identity, and ~90% Flutter implementation shipped to Apple App Store.
- **Product & UI/UX Designer — Corevine (Egypt)**: Collaborated 1:1 with a Bosta PM founder and engineering team to design the two-sided Tride Parent & Driver school mobility apps shipped on App Store and Google Play.
- **Product & UX/UI Designer — Design Agency, New Capital (Egypt / KSA)**: Rebuilt Malahi's enterprise 3D entertainment and online ticketing portal across age-segmented destinations, using AI Vibe-Coding prototypes and developer media performance tuning.
- **Product Designer & Flutter Contributor — Active KSA (Saudi Arabia)**: Shipped UX and Flutter product features transforming WhatsApp agency operations into a live Saudi Web, Dashboard & mobile creator marketplace with MyFatoorah payments and third-party audience analytics.
